remaining: Production collector and exporter interoperability beyond pinned Collector Contrib 0.130.0 is unverified.
TLS/mTLS, exporter authentication, retry/backoff, collector outage, queue saturation, shutdown flushing and remote deployment remain unverified.
Prompt/credential privacy semantics remain unverified: CP62 did not submit sensitive content and CP61 sink did not decode protobuf.
Windows/macOS and cluster deployment remain unverified.

limitations: The collector configuration used the debug exporter for a local integration check; it does not demonstrate a production telemetry backend.
Only one synthetic unauthorized request was deliberately generated in CP62; the collector also saw periodic runtime metrics.
No source/spec modifications or paid provider calls were made.
